Questions 1–10

Complete the form below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

OPENING A BANK ACCOUNT

OPENING A BANK ACCOUNT
Example Answer Application for a Current bank account
  • Type of current account: The account
  • Full name of applicant: Pieter Henes
  • Date of birth:
  • Joint account holder(s): No
  • Current address: Exeter
  • Time at current address:
  • Previous address: Rielsdorf 2, Utrecht, Holland
  • Telephone: work Home 796431
  • Occupation:
  • Identity (security): Name of his : Siti
  • Opening sum: € to be transferred from Fransen Bank, Utrecht
  • Statements: Every
Requests: Supply information about the bank's service

transcript.en: Good morning.I'd like to open a bank account, please.
Certainly. If you'd like to take a seat, I'll just get some details from you. It won't take long.
transcript.zh: 好的。你先坐，我先录入点信息不会耽误太久。

transcript.en: Thanks.
Is it a current account or a deposit account you wanted?
A current account.
Right. I've got the application form here then.
transcript.zh: 好的。我这里有一张申请表。

transcript.en: We have different types — I see you've got our leaflet there.
transcript.zh: 我们有很多种类，我看到你已经拿了一张宣传单了。

transcript.en: I've decided on the one called 'Select'.
Right, that's fine, so, first of all, can I have your full name please?
transcript.zh: 好的，首先，你能告诉我你的全名吗？

transcript.en: Yes, it's Pieter Henes. That's P-I-E-T-E-R.
Is it H-E-double N-E-S?
Uh, only one N actually. It's a less common spelling of the name.
transcript.zh: 只有一个N这样的拼写不常见

transcript.en: Oh, right.
OK.
And what's your date of birth please?
The twenty-seventh of the first, nineteen seventy-three.
Right. And will this be a joint account?
No, just myself.
OK, fine. And where are you living, Mr. Henes?
15, Riverside.
Is that all one word?
Yes.
Exeter?
Yes.
How long have you been at your present address? Er, is it more than two years?
transcript.zh: 住了多久了？超过两年了吗？

transcript.en: Ah, just two weeks actually. I only arrived in the country a month ago. I'm from Holland.
transcript.zh: 就两周，我上个月才来到这里，我来自荷兰。

transcript.en: Oh, that's fine. But we normally ask for a previous address in that case.
transcript.zh: 没关系，我们通常要问下住址

transcript.en: Oh yes, well, it's Rielsdorf 2. That's R-I-E-L-S-D-O-R-F 2, Utrecht.
Holland OK. Thank you. Do you have a daytime telephone number?
transcript.zh: 荷兰 好的。谢谢有白天能打通的电话吗

transcript.en: Yes, I think the number at my office is six-oh-six-two-nine-five, Um, just a minute. I'd better check.
transcript.zh: 是的，我想我办公室的电话是606295，我最好确定一下

transcript.en: Oh, no sorry, six-one-six. I'm not used to it yet.
Would you like my home number too?
Yes please.
It's seven-nine-six-four-three-one.
Are they both local numbers?
Yes.
Right. And your occupation?
Well, I'm in Britain as a project manager, but that's not my main job. I'm an engineer by profession.
transcript.zh: 我在英国做项目经理，但是这不是我的主要工作，我是一名工程师。

transcript.en: I see. I think I'll put that then. It's shorter!
transcript.zh: 明白，我写那个吧，比较短

transcript.en: Now we usually ask for a piece of information which we can use to check your identity, for security reasons.
transcript.zh: 出于安全考虑，我们通常要询问一些用来核对身份的信息。

transcript.en: You know, if you phone us.
transcript.zh: 如果你给我们打电话的话，

transcript.en: Like, erm, my wife's first name?
Mother's might be better. It's less likely to be known.
transcript.zh: 最好是母亲姓什么，更少有人知道。

transcript.en: OK, Hers is Siti.
Siti?
Yes, S-I-T-I. It's Indonesian.
Fine. And how much would you like to open your account with? We usually ask for a minimum sum of￡50. That's about €75.
transcript.zh: 好，你要用多少钱开账户最少50英镑，大概75欧元。

transcript.en: Well, I'm going to transfer €2,000 from my Dutch account, just till I get paid.
transcript.zh: 在我收到付款后，我会从我的荷兰账户转来2000欧元。

transcript.en: In fact, I wanted to ask you about that. What's the best way to do it?
transcript.zh: 事实上我想问你什么是最好的的办法

transcript.en: It depends which bank you're with.
transcript.zh: 这取决于你是哪家银行。

transcript.en: It's the Fransen Bank in Utrecht.
transcript.zh: 乌特勒支的弗朗森银行。

transcript.en: OK, fine. I'll check that in a minute.
If we have links with them we can do a direct transfer. But it's not a big problem either way.
transcript.zh: 如果我们有链接，我们可以直接为你转账这都不是问题。

transcript.en: Um, let's see. How often would you like to receive statements?
transcript.zh: 我看看你希望多久收到结算清单？

transcript.en: I haven't really thought. Um, what's the usual thing?
It's up to you. Some people like them weekly.
transcript.zh: 看你，有些人喜欢一周一次。

transcript.en: Oh, no, that's too often.
Can I have them sent, um, once a month?
Yes, that's fine. Is there anything else?
transcript.zh: 可以的，还有其他事情吗？

transcript.en: I was thinking of registering for your internet service at some stage.
transcript.zh: 我想注册你们的网络服务。

transcript.en: Oh, yes.
Would you like me to send you information about that?
transcript.zh: 要我把相关信息发给你吗？

transcript.en: Please, yes.
And would you like to receive information about the bank's other services - insurance, loans, anything like that?
transcript.zh: 你想接收银行的其他服务信息吗，比如保险、贷款之类的？

transcript.en: Hmm, I don't think so. Thanks.
That's OK then.
And one last thing, if you agree...
transcript.zh: 如果你同意，下一件事是……
